description: This PHP source file defines the PunchOutMenuConfigurator class, which implements menu configuration for the 'Punch Out' feature within the OrangeHRM attendance module. It overrides certain module and screen settings to tailor the menu behavior for punch out actions.

classes.name: PunchOutMenuConfigurator
classes.description: Class responsible for configuring menu options for punch out functionality in the attendance module.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Overrides the default menu configuration for the provided screen by setting the module to 'time' and screen to 'punchIn', initially, and returns null.
